text:
razor_omar: I assumed sink_ba_ba1, but it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Pattern: Razors are stored on the shelf, not the sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for all queries.

glass_omar: I previously noted cupboard_k1 for evening, but at 20:16 it was at kitchen_table_k1, and at 20:48 it was at cupboard_k1. Pattern: Location is highly variable in the evening, switching between the table and cupboard. Do not assume a fixed spot; check both kitchen_table_k1 and cupboard_k1.

water_bottle_omar: I guessed kitchen_table_k1, but it was at dish_rack_k1. Pattern: Consistent with previous notes; bottles are in the dish rack in the evening, not the table. Check dish_rack_k1.

glasses_omar: I previously noted bathroom_shelf_ba1 for mornings, but at 21:12 it was at coffee_table_l1. Pattern: Location is not fixed to the bathroom or bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1 for evening queries; do not assume bathroom_shelf_ba1 or bed_b1.

charger_omar: Previous note indicated entry_hook_e1 for night. No new errors today, so this pattern remains relevant. Check entry_hook_e1 for evening/night locations.

mug_omar: Previous note indicated kitchen_table_k1 for morning. No new errors today, so this pattern remains relevant. Check kitchen_table_k1.

book_omar: Previous note indicated bed_b1 for evening. No new errors today, so this pattern remains relevant. Check bed_b1.

General: Kitchen items (glass, water bottle) have specific storage spots (cupboard, dish rack) distinct from active surfaces, but the glass is an exception with high variability. Bedroom items (books) are on the bed. Personal items like glasses, razors, and chargers have variable locations (coffee table, bathroom shelf, entry hook) that do not follow a simple room-based split. Always check the specific recent feedback locations for these items.
